governingFramework: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
framework: EPF & MP Act 1952; Payment of Gratuity Act 1972
sourceTitle: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) — Present Contribution Rates
notes: Salary package assumptions for FY 2025-26. Standard basic salary assumed at 40% of CTC, HRA at 40% of basic. EPF statutory ceiling is ₹15,000 monthly with 12% employer and 12% employee contribution. State-specific professional tax and income-tax TDS deductions are not included.
